title: Val's Original Tiles and Graphic Resource s

posts.author: ValentinaSama67
posts.body:
Hey everyone!
As some of you might know, I draw and I make assets specifically for RMaker, and since I do have free assets available, I decided to dump them here as well, specially since I also plan to make more RM specific resources, like remaking the RTP characters in my style.
Spoiler:
TERMS OF USE
You
CAN NOT
redistribute or resell any of the assets contained in this pack.
You can use these assets in any RPG Maker engin since they are 100% original.
You can use the assets in this pack for commercial projects.
You can edit, recolor or remix the assets. (If you want to share any edits you made, you must contact me first)
Credit is not required but highly appreciated.
I welcome suggestions
for future assets and additions to already existing ones, but do keep in mind
this is not
a resource request thread.
